sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: One of the Fabula brothers, the illustrators from ancient Seltavia's storybooks. His heartwarming illustrations, reflective of his personality, were beloved across generations. It is said that Lubi, who was always by his side, was an embodiment of the strong bond manifested from the illustrations he drew. One day, his brother mysteriously disappeared, leading to a series of strange events in the town. When he was attacked by rioting townsfolk, Lubi granted him the power to fight.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Brilliant Painter Letiste |bf2 = true }} '''Letiste''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== One of the Fabula brothers, the illustrators from ancient Seltavia's storybooks. His heartwarming illustrations, reflective of his personality, were beloved across generations. It is said that Lubi, who was always by his side, was an embodiment of the strong bond manifested from the illustrations he drew. One day, his brother mysteriously disappeared, leading to a series of strange events in the town. When he was attacked by rioting townsfolk, Lubi granted him the power to fight. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Letiste |element = Light |image1 = Navi chara bf2 142 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 142 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 142 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 142 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 142 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 142 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 142 6.png |image7note = |image8 = Navi chara bf2 142 7.png |image8note = |image9 = Navi chara bf2 142 8.png |image9note = |image10 = Navi chara bf2 142 9.png |image10note = }} ==Trivia==
